title: Beef star and K-pop idol Matthew Kim can't wait to be on his computer | SHELF QUEST
description:
K-pop idol and actor Matthew Kim (or Big Matthew, as fans of the group KARD know him) moved to Korea to pursue a career in entertainment — but games keep him in touch with his family. His love of video games started with his father, who was "nasty" on Super Mario, and continues today when he plays Call of Duty: Warzone with his little brother.

In 2026 Kim made his acting debut in season 2 of Netflix's hit series Beef. We met up with Kim during a blitz of publicity around the show's launch, and he was hyped to chill and talk about video games. From the ways that games bring him closer to his family, to the reasons he prefers not to play in Korean servers, Kim has made gaming an escape from the busy world of entertainment — even when his brothers are whooping his butt.

*IMPORTANT LINKS*

Polygon Newsletter: https://www.polygon.com/pages/newsletter
TikTok: tiktok.com/@polygon
Twitter: http://bit.ly/PolygonTwitter
Instagram: http://bit.ly/PolygonInsta
Facebook: http://bit.ly/PolygonFB
And for more gaming and entertainment coverage, visit http://www.polygon.com

#Beef #MatthewKim #BM #shelfquest
